decision_local_quality_diagnostic.role: diagnostic and inner-loop search channel only; DeltaQ is not the entry-component freeze claim and cannot substitute for serial dollars
decision_local_quality_diagnostic.unit_of_evaluation: one minute on the universal governed serial entry grid
decision_local_quality_diagnostic.buy_action: the exact successfully filled selected contract

component_transform.dual_unit_arbitration: minimum of dollar and return transformed values after both are ranked within the same decision-time premium band and market phase
component_transform.censored_or_invalid: component missing for supervised scoring; never zero-imputed and never exposed to runtime composition

family_aggregation.within_horizon: equal mean of non-timestamp registered metrics after dual-unit arbitration
family_aggregation.across_horizons: equal mean over the causally available horizons frozen by composer_spec.json
family_aggregation.quality_family_score: equal mean within each of early_drawdown, time_to_first_real_profit, pre_profit_adverse_excursion, underwater_burden, profitable_window_stability
family_aggregation.whole_path_quality_Q: equal mean of the five quality-family scores
family_aggregation.insufficient_family: a filled BUY with any required quality family unavailable is invalid evidence and fails closed

paired_diagnostics.DeltaQ_session: mean over the universal governed serial minute grid of Q_candidate-Q_comparator
paired_diagnostics.DeltaU_session: mean over the same grid of U_candidate-U_comparator
required_reports: WAIT, BUY, PENDING, OCCUPIED, failed-fill counts
side, moneyness, premium-band, phase, and missingness distributions

nested_empirical_cdf.purpose: make dual dollar/return arbitration reproducible without a deterministic middle-premium preference
nested_empirical_cdf.reference_population: for each outer fold, inner fit, metric, horizon, unit, premium band, and phase: eligible finite full-window FT2-04 label values joined to governed rows from only the sessions used to fit that model; exclude the scored inner block, its embargo, chronological future blocks, census-only sessions not in the fit role, outer validation, confirmation, protected holdout, and live data
nested_empirical_cdf.premium_band_assignment: use the causal completed-minute executable ask at decision t and the five census-v3 boundaries in composer_spec.json; never use the future t+1 fill ask to choose a runtime band

full_window_filter.finite_horizon: include hN continuous/count/CDF reference values only when censored=false, deadline_ns=entry_fill_time_ns+N*60 seconds, nominal_minutes=N, available_minutes=N, and every required mark in (entry_fill_time,deadline] is represented under the primary no-bid-as-full-loss rule
full_window_filter.remaining_session: include continuous/count/CDF reference values only when censored=false, deadline is exact 15:55 America/New_York, and the complete registered remaining-session grid is represented
full_window_filter.finite_but_censored_near_close: excluded from every empirical-CDF reference population; never treated as a shorter full horizon
full_window_filter.time_to_event_exception: right-censored first-profit targets are handled only by the registered discrete-survival likelihood and its censoring indicator; they do not enter continuous empirical-CDF references as finite events
full_window_filter.filter_source: FT2-04 label metadata only inside the label-side fit pipeline; the filter is never exposed to runtime composition

nested_empirical_cdf.market_phase_assignment: use the FT2-08 causal market_phase_id at decision t
nested_empirical_cdf.scope: one CDF per metric x horizon x unit x premium_band x market_phase; no pooling across metrics, horizons, or units

weighting.session: each contributing session has weight 1/S within the stratum
weighting.row_within_session: each finite reference row in a contributing session has weight 1/n_session_stratum
weighting.result: session-balanced rather than decision-row- or contract-row-dominated

ties_and_interpolation.between_adjacent_distinct_values: linear interpolation between their midrank knots in value space

fallback_order: same premium_band pooled over all training-fit market phases
nested_empirical_cdf.fallback_receipt: record exact stratum, contributing session identities, row counts, total weights, fallback level, and canonical CDF hash
nested_empirical_cdf.same_band_insufficient: metric/horizon/unit rank unavailable; affected contract fails closed

nesting.inner_search: build every CDF from that inner model's fit sessions only before scoring the next block
nesting.final_outer_model: build CDFs from final_model_fit sessions only; final_calibration and outer-validation rows are never included

nested_empirical_cdf.canonical_hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, finite decimal strings, and ordered knots

serial_primary_population.universal_grid: every governed completed flat-entry decision minute from the first action-eligible minute through 15:29 America/New_York on every governed session, ordered by session then decision_time_ns
serial_primary_population.occupied_minute_treatment: a policy that is pending or occupied has no flat-state action at that minute; record PENDING or OCCUPIED, assign Q=0 and U=0, retain the minute in paired population denominators, and never score a counterfactual BUY
serial_primary_population.wait_accounting: WAIT is available only while flat, has Q=0, U=0, and serial dollars 0 for that minute, and remains in every denominator

entry_commit_and_fill.intent_population: at decision t assemble affordability, D48, D49, and premium-floor masks only from the last known executable ask A_t and the causal policy ledger; A_(t+1), its existence, freshness, or outcome is forbidden
entry_commit_and_fill.commit: select one exact identity from the t-intent population and reserve the one-position slot at decision t
entry_commit_and_fill.pending: no second action is allowed at t+1 while the t+1 executable fill outcome is resolved
entry_commit_and_fill.fill: successful BUY uses the actual t+1 executable ask, one contract, and the active fee trajectory
fill_time_rechecks_selected_identity_onl: exact identity and fresh executable ask at t+1
D48 actual premium plus active fee
D49 policy-ledger realized loss plus actual premium plus active fee
entry_commit_and_fill.failed_fill: no t+1 ask or a failed selected-identity fill-time safety recheck opens no position, charges no premium or fee, realizes no PnL, permits no substitute, records failed execution with Q=U=0, and returns to flat no earlier than decision t+2

account_and_safety_state.D48: floor(0.05*policy session-start equity cents) and actual entry cost cents<=that budget
account_and_safety_state.D49: policy realized_session_loss_cents+actual entry cost cents<=policy daily budget cents
account_and_safety_state.soft_close: at every flat decision and independently per fee path, permanently WAIT for new entries when the current exact ladder contains no otherwise-eligible contract with A_t>=100 cents whose D48 and D49 intent masks pass; compute the arithmetic floor as 100*100+active_fee_cents (10300 fee_3, 10400 fee_4), never as a shared literal
account_and_safety_state.daily_stop: signed policy realized_session_pnl_cents<=-policy daily budget cents blocks new entries
account_and_safety_state.fee_paths: run $3 and $4 as separate causal trajectories; metrics-only fee subtraction is forbidden

neutral_lifecycle.rule: hold every successful entry without a learned exit to the exact 15:55 America/New_York forced-flat boundary
neutral_lifecycle.exit_value: actual executable 15:55 bid; zero option value when no executable boundary bid; no earlier-bid substitution
neutral_lifecycle.occupancy: from successful t+1 fill through the single 15:55 realization
neutral_lifecycle.reason: the entry component does not own exits; this uncapped common rule supplies causal occupancy and dollar/safety accounting without making a fixed exit the learned entry objective

serial_primary_population.re_entry_law: after any realized exit fill, a policy may next act only at the first later completed decision minute at which it is flat and t<15:30; under the frozen hold-to-15:55 neutral lifecycle a successful fill therefore permits no same-session re-entry, while a failed t+1 fill may retry at t+2
serial_primary_population.paired_comparison: candidate, P5, every control, every seed, and every alpha arm traverse the same universal grid but each mutates only its own causal cash, occupancy, D48, D49, soft-close, and daily-stop ledger

p5_under_cap_algorithm.name: P5_VWAP_SIDE_NEAREST_ELIGIBLE_UNDER_CAP_V2
p5_under_cap_algorithm.role: mandatory comparator only; never an upstream filter, label, feature, or final architecture
p5_under_cap_algorithm.inputs: causal completed-minute SPX close, causal session VWAP, exact current 42-slot ladder identities, current offsets, and that P5 ledger's time-t physical/safety intent mask built from A_t only
p5_under_cap_algorithm.timing: at every universal-grid minute where P5 is flat, not pending, t<15:30, and global entry masks pass, attempt an entry; there is no learned P5 abstention threshold
p5_under_cap_algorithm.side: C when finite spx_close>=finite spx_vwap, otherwise P; missing or nonfinite state means WAIT
p5_under_cap_algorithm.eligible_set: contracts of the selected side whose current t quote, identity, tradability, affordability, 100-cent floor, complete-ladder, warmup, freshness, P5-ledger D48 intent, and P5-ledger D49 intent masks all pass without t+1 information
wait_behavior: WAIT when P5 is pending or occupied, recorded structurally rather than as a flat choice
WAIT when global entry masks fail
WAIT when SPX/VWAP state is missing or nonfinite
WAIT when no selected-side contract is eligible
WAIT permanently after P5's own soft-close or daily stop
p5_under_cap_algorithm.fill_and_ledger: after selecting from the t-intent population, recheck only the selected exact identity at t+1 under serial_primary_population, then use the neutral lifecycle, re-entry law, and P5's own causal account ledger
p5_under_cap_algorithm.target_and_forecast_independence: P5 may not read labels, forecast heads, future quote availability, candidate actions, or another policy's ledger
p5_under_cap_algorithm.hashing: this complete object is pinned by objective_spec.json SHA-256 in receipt.json; any algorithm change is a new contract version

entry_component_freeze.claim_scope: freeze the entry layer as a component for later combined-system evaluation

quality_evidence: registered head families demonstrate nested out-of-fold skill versus constant-output and strong-shuffle controls under FT2-11 statistics
mandatory WAIT-probability and selected-regret gate passes
all five quality-family effects and upside are reported; no materially harmful family may be hidden
safety: all FT2-08 integrity, identity, complete-ladder, D48, D49, soft-close, daily-stop, no-bid, forced-flat, and separate-fee-trajectory gates pass
one contract, one position, no overlap, and account-survival gates pass

no_harm_vs_p5_serial_dollars.estimand: DeltaSerialDollar_session=Pnl_cents_candidate-Pnl_cents_P5 on every common governed session under the separate causal neutral-lifecycle ledgers; a no-trade session contributes zero policy PnL rather than disappearing
no_harm_vs_p5_serial_dollars.statistical_noninferiority_margin_and_ad: owned by the FT2-11 repair and must be frozen before campaign results

can_claim: entry forecasts and composer earned a component freeze under quality, safety, tail, and serial-dollar no-harm evidence
the frozen entry component may proceed to the lifecycle and combined-system stages named by the graph
cannot_claim: the entry component makes more money than P5
the entry component is promotable by itself
the complete Full Trader is profitable
entry_component_freeze.promotable_dollar_claim_owner: combined FT2-80 evaluation after learned entry and learned lifecycle are assembled
entry_component_freeze.source_transfer_topology: candidate-specific historical/IBKR transfer is not an entry-component acceptance precondition. A frozen component may carry transfer_not_yet_run into the graph; FT2-92 performs the transfer measurement, and its pass is mandatory before FT2-93 or later live activation.
entry_component_freeze.combined_lifecycle_boundary: the one-trade neutral lifecycle answers component quality and safety only. Live/combined behavior with learned exits and possible re-entry must be re-evaluated on complete combined-system ledgers at FT2-80; component freeze makes no live-parity or incremental-edge claim.

tail_guard_relative_capture.control: the alpha=0.0 no-screen arm using the same trained model, CDFs, calibrators, k, physical/safety masks, serial state machine, and fee path as the evaluated alpha arm
tail_guard_relative_capture.big_win_definition: remaining-session MFE fee-adjusted return>=0.40 under FT2-04 v2

per_arm_metrics.big_win_entries_per_governed_session: count of successfully filled entries satisfying big_win_definition divided by all governed sessions
per_arm_metrics.big_win_opportunity_dollars_per_governed: sum max(0,remaining-session MFE fee-adjusted dollars) over those big-win entries divided by all governed sessions
per_arm_metrics.positive_serial_pnl_concentration_from_b: sum max(0,neutral-lifecycle PnL dollars) for entries satisfying big_win_definition divided by sum max(0,neutral-lifecycle PnL dollars) over all entries

tail_guard_relative_capture.relative_metrics: for each per-arm metric, evaluated-alpha value divided by alpha=0.0 value on the same fold/seed/session set
tail_guard_relative_capture.zero_control_denominator: tail_guard_insufficient_evidence; never impute one or declare pass
tail_guard_relative_capture.evaluation_scope: every serious candidate, outer fold, seed, frozen ensemble, $3 primary path, and $4 stress path; all alpha grid arms are retained
tail_guard_relative_capture.ft2_11_dependency: FT2-11 repair freezes cluster-aware uncertainty, session-clustered intervals, material relative-capture thresholds, multiplicity, and the owner-decision tripwire before results
tail_guard_relative_capture.breach: owner_decision_required; an excluded alpha arm may not be silently selected
tail_guard_relative_capture.not_an_optimization_target: Charter bucket proximity and tail ratios may not enter training loss, model selection score, or early stopping

eligibility_before_scoring: identity, complete-ladder, and policy-ledger mask checks valid
nested CDF and final calibration machinery valid
mandatory action-conditioned heads present and trainable

ordered_terms.maximize: one-sided 80 percent session-block lower bound of diagnostic DeltaQ versus P5
one-sided 80 percent session-block lower bound of diagnostic DeltaU versus P5
minimum of the five quality-family diagnostic lower bounds

ordered_terms.minimize: measured inference latency then materialized bytes without changing the scientific contract

inner_loop_objective.forbidden_interpretation: winning this search does not freeze the component and is not a dollar or promotion claim
inner_loop_objective.final_entry_component_evidence: entry_component_freeze in this file plus FT2-11 repaired statistical checklist

resampling_noise_and_plateau.method: noncircular moving-block bootstrap; FT2-11 repair owns final dependence validity
resampling_noise_and_plateau.comparison: candidate minus current incumbent on the same nested inner-scored sessions

plateau_counter.failed_or_incomplete_trial: does not reset and counts only if it consumed a registered serious-trial slot

resampling_noise_and_plateau.scope: search guidance only; no final scientific acceptance

no_reward_hacking: no absolute PnL optimization for entry training
no label or metric selected after outer results
no dropping WAIT, PENDING, OCCUPIED, failed-fill, or zero-trade session rows
no family may be removed because it hurts results
no fixed-exit profit may substitute for whole-path quality or serial-dollar no-harm
no P5 opportunity filtering of the learned action space
no tail metric in loss or selection
no outer validation feedback into model, composer, calibration, stopping, CDF, or tail threshold
